features.name: any_comment_quotes_or_references_op_text
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment explicitly quote or reference a specific textual element of the original post?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments). Return 1 if at least one comment explicitly quotes (verbatim or near-verbatim, e.g. block quote or quotation marks matching OP wording) or explicitly points to a specific passage, sentence, phrase, claim or wording of the OP's title or argument (e.g. 'you said X', 'your point about Y in the post'). Use title and argument only to verify that the quoted/referenced element comes from the OP post. Generic references to the OP's overall view without a specific textual element do not count. Quotation marks alone do not suffice if the text is not from the OP post. Ignore OP view-change/delta announcements and post-outcome resolution updates as evidence. Return 0 if no comment qualifies or the list is empty; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed.

h0: any_comment_quotes_or_references_op_text has no association with the probability of view change (delta).
h1: Rows with any_comment_quotes_or_references_op_text = 1 have a higher probability of view change.
note: Operationalized as "at least one comment" for "discussions containing" such counter-arguments. Linear probability model on binary delta. Comments may be from after the OP's text was edited; the current text may contain edits or outcome announcements, and comment timing is unknown. Association only.
